name: Zoning
definition: A space divides into areas with one activity each. A rug, a light, a ceiling change or a group of furniture marks a zone without a wall.

measures.reference: rug, pendant, floor level, ceiling level, furniture back

sources.title: Francis D. K. Ching, Architecture: Form, Space, and Order (Wiley, 4th edition, 2014)
Ernst and Peter Neufert, Architects' Data (Wiley-Blackwell, 4th English edition, 2012)
